title: for...of and for...in
learningObjectives: Explain for...of and for...in and choose an appropriate control-flow structure.

understand.concept: for...of iterates over values from an iterable such as arrays, strings, maps, and sets. for...in iterates over enumerable string property keys, commonly on objects. They are not interchangeable: for...in on an array iterates keys rather than values.
understand.whyItMatters: Using the wrong loop can produce unexpected keys or include inherited enumerable properties. Prefer for...of for iterable values and suitable object methods for own entries.
understand.analogy: for...of visits the items; for...in visits the property names.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; JavaScript control flow follows precise condition evaluation and iteration semantics.

explain.narrative: The first loop prints array values. The second prints own enumerable keys and their values from the object.

examples.explanation: The first loop prints array values. The second prints own enumerable keys and their values from the object.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser console displays the sequence or branch results described.

practise.guidedTask: Use for...of to process an array and Object.entries() to process an object's key/value pairs. Explain why for...in is not the default array loop.
practise.independentTask: Write a small program that uses the control-flow structure to process learner or course data. Test normal, boundary, and empty cases.
hints: Use strict comparisons for exact values.
Choose for...of for iterable values and avoid confusing keys with values.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>for...of and for...in</title></head><body>
<script>const topics=['HTML','CSS','JavaScript'];for(const topic of topics){console.log(topic);}const learner={name:'Asha',level:'Beginner'};for(const key in learner){if(Object.hasOwn(learner,key))console.log(key,learner[key]);}</script>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which loop iterates over values from an iterable?
questions.explanation: for...of obtains values from the iterable's iterator.
